title: Role-Based Authentication and Access Control
description: Verify that users can log in with appropriate roles and access permissions are enforced correctly across the system.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Log in as Administrator with valid credentials
Verify access to full system controls, financial dashboards, user and inventory management
Log out
Log in as Physiotherapist with valid credentials
Verify access to patient management, documenting clinical evolutions, scheduling, and exercise prescription
Log out
Log in as Intern with valid credentials
Verify limited access to patient and scheduling views only
Log out
Log in as Patient with valid credentials
Verify access to patient portal with medical records, prescribed exercises, and appointment requests
Attempt to access unauthorized admin and physiotherapist features
Verify access is denied

title: Patient Management Full Data Input and Search
description: Test full patient data input, medical history addition, and search functionality with filtering and interactive pain mapping.

steps.description: Login as Physiotherapist
Navigate to Patient Management page
Create new patient with detailed profile including demographics, medical history and pain mapping
Verify patient is saved successfully with all data correctly displayed
Use search filter with multiple criteria (name, age range, condition)
Verify search results correctly match criteria
Edit existing patient to add additional medical history entry and update pain mapping
Verify data updates are saved and reflected in patient details
Attempt to input invalid patient data (e.g., invalid date format, missing mandatory fields)
Verify validations prevent saving and appropriate error messages shown

title: Appointment Scheduling Conflict Prevention and Recurrence
description: Verify appointment scheduling supports multiple therapists, prevents scheduling conflicts, handles recurring events, and sends notifications.

steps.description: Login as Physiotherapist
Navigate to Appointment Scheduling calendar
Schedule appointment with Therapist A at a given date and time
Verify appointment is created and visible in the calendar
Attempt to schedule overlapping appointment with Therapist A at same date/time
Verify scheduling conflict warning appears and appointment is not allowed
Schedule another appointment for different therapist at the same time
Verify appointment is allowed and visible
Create a recurring appointment weekly for Therapist A
Verify all occurrences are created and visible
Edit one occurrence in recurring series
Verify change applies only to selected occurrence with proper versioning
Verify notifications are sent for appointments created, updated, or cancelled

title: SOAP Notes Editor Autosave and Version Control
description: Test the SOAP notes editor autosaves input changes regularly and manages version history correctly including template usage.

steps.description: Login as Physiotherapist
Open Patient Evolution editor for a session
Manually enter free text notes in Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan fields
Verify autosave triggers after input changes without manual save
Modify notes again and verify autosave triggers a new version
Open version history and verify multiple saved versions with timestamps
Restore an older version
Verify content reverts accordingly
Apply a SOAP note template
Verify template fields populate correctly and can be edited
Close editor without manual save and re-open
Verify latest autosaved content loads

title: AI Audio Transcription Accuracy and Error Handling
description: Verify that audio recordings of physiotherapist spoken notes are transcribed accurately with Google Gemini and handle transcription errors gracefully.

steps.description: Login as Physiotherapist
Open Evolution Editor and start an audio recording via the AI Audio Transcription feature
Speak a standard physiotherapy evolution note clearly
Verify the spoken audio is transcribed automatically into text accurately (≥95% accuracy)
Stop recording and edit the transcribed text
Verify edits are saved correctly
Simulate network or API failure during transcription
Verify error message shows, recording can be retried, and partial transcription is preserved if any

title: AI SOAP Structuring of Free Text Notes
description: Validate that AI properly structures free-text evolution notes into standardized SOAP format with correct segmentation.

steps.description: Login as Physiotherapist
Enter unstructured free text notes describing patient's current status
Invoke AI SOAP Structuring feature
Verify that the text is accurately segmented into Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan fields
Modify any field manually and save
Verify changes are saved and can be restored via version control
Invoke AI SOAP Structuring on ambiguous or incomplete text
Verify AI provides meaningful structure or prompts for clarification

title: AI Exercise Suggestion Based on Patient Data
description: Verify that the AI suggests appropriate therapeutic exercises based on diagnosis, pain location, functional limitations, and treatment goals.

steps.description: Login as Physiotherapist
Open patient profile with diagnosis, pain location, limitations, and goals entered
Trigger AI Exercise Suggestion feature from Evolution Editor
Verify suggested exercises are relevant, categorized, and multimedia rich
Select suggested exercises to add to patient prescription
Verify exercises are added correctly with personalization options
Trigger exercise suggestion with incomplete/ambiguous patient data
Verify AI handles the scenario gracefully by requesting more info or returning general suggestions

title: AI Progress Summary Generation and Accuracy
description: Test that AI generates comprehensive and accurate progress summaries over multiple sessions with correct clinical terminology.

steps.description: Login as Physiotherapist
Navigate to Patient Progress Summary page
Select patient with multiple treatment sessions
Trigger AI Progress Summary generation
Verify summary is generated with clinical accuracy at or above 95%
Edit generated summary and save
Verify edits persist and appear in future views
Trigger summary generation with minimal session data
Verify AI handles limited data gracefully and creates meaningful summaries or appropriate messages

title: Patient Portal Secure Access and Personalized Data
description: Verify that patients can securely log in, view their personalized medical records, access prescribed exercises, and communicate with the clinic.

steps.description: Login as Patient using valid credentials
Verify secure session is established and session management works correctly
Navigate to medical records section
Verify only patient's own data is displayed accurately
Access prescribed therapeutic exercises
Verify multimedia content loads and personalization is correct
Send a communication message or appointment request via portal
Verify message is sent successfully and proper confirmation shown
Attempt to access another patient's data via url or direct navigation
Verify access is denied and user is redirected or shown error

title: Dashboards Reflect Accurate Metrics and Export Capability
description: Test that operational, clinical, and financial dashboards display accurate analytics and support data export.

steps.description: Login as Administrator
Navigate to financial and clinical dashboards
Verify metrics displayed (revenue, payments, clinical sessions, patient progress) match underlying data
Use filters (date range, therapist, patient group) to modify dashboard views
Verify dashboard updates accordingly with accurate data
Export dashboard data in supported formats (e.g., CSV, PDF)
Verify exported data matches displayed dashboard data and is formatted correctly

title: Financial Management: Payment Tracking and Multiple Payment Methods
description: Verify that the financial management system correctly tracks payments, supports invoicing, and various payment methods.

steps.description: Login as Administrator
Navigate to financial management dashboard
Record a payment using different methods (credit card, cash, bank transfer)
Verify payment status updates correctly and reflects in revenue tracking
Generate invoice for a patient with itemized billing
Verify invoice displays correct details, totals, and patient info
Attempt to record invalid payment data (e.g., negative amount, missing method)
Verify validation prevents submission and shows appropriate errors

title: Inventory Management: Stock Alerts and Transaction History
description: Ensure inventory system tracks stock levels, triggers alerts on low stock, and maintains transaction logs.

steps.description: Login as Administrator
Navigate to inventory management system
Add items with initial stock quantities
Verify items appear in inventory list with correct stock levels
Simulate usage to reduce stock below alert threshold
Verify low stock alert notification is triggered
View transaction history for an inventory item
Verify transactions (additions, usage, removals) are logged with timestamps and user information

title: Task Management System: Prioritization, Progress Tracking, and Notifications
description: Test task creation with prioritization, progress updates, and notification delivery to users.

steps.description: Login as any user with task management access
Create a new task with specific priority and deadlines
Verify task appears in user's task list with correct priority and due date
Update task progress status (e.g., in progress, completed)
Verify progress updates are saved and reflected in task list
Assign tasks to other users and verify notifications are sent
Verify assigned users receive notifications and tasks appear in their lists
Attempt to input invalid task data such as missing required fields
Verify validation errors are shown and task is not saved

title: System Performance Under Load and Page Load Times
description: Verify system meets performance criteria of under 2-second page load times under average and peak loads.

steps.description: Simulate user login and navigation to various key pages (dashboard, patient management, scheduling)
Measure and verify page loads in under 2 seconds on average
Simulate peak concurrent users (stress test) accessing system features
Verify system remains responsive and average page load time stays below 2 seconds
Confirm system uptime is 99.5% or higher during test period

title: Data Protection Compliance: Encryption and Audit Logging
description: Verify that all sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and audit logs are maintained for critical operations.

steps.description: Login as Administrator
Perform sensitive operations (e.g., access patient records, update financial data)
Verify audit logs capture operation details, user ID, timestamps, and IP address
Inspect network traffic during login and data access
Verify data is encrypted using HTTPS / TLS protocols
Verify data at rest (database/storage) is encrypted
Attempt unauthorized data access and verify system blocks access and logs the attempt
